reasoning: To protect the crown-jewel data stores, we prioritized internet-facing vulnerabilities on edge assets that provide initial entry vectors into the network. Fixing these critical and KEV-listed findings effectively severs external attacker routes to internal systems and sensitive data.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev,
  ds.id AS ds_id,
  ds.sensitivity
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e_on.dst = a.id
JOIN edges e_runs ON e_runs.src = a.id AND e_runs.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software s ON e_runs.dst = s.id
JOIN edges e_vuln ON e_vuln.src = s.id AND e_vuln.type = 'HAS_VULN'
JOIN vulns v ON e_vuln.dst = v.id
CROSS JOIN datastores ds
WHERE ds.crown_jewel = true
  AND f.status = 'open'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev,
  e_exp.type AS exposed_from_internet
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e_on.dst = a.id
LEFT JOIN edges e_exp ON e_exp.dst = a.id AND e_exp.src = 'internet'
JOIN edges e_runs ON e_runs.src = a.id AND e_runs.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software s ON e_runs.dst = s.id
JOIN edges e_vuln ON e_vuln.src = s.id AND e_vuln.type = 'HAS_VULN' AND e_vuln.dst = f.id -- wait, OF connects finding to vuln
LIMIT 5

input.sql:
SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev,
  CASE WHEN e_exp.src = 'internet' THEN true ELSE false END AS internet_facing
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e_on.dst = a.id
LEFT JOIN edges e_exp ON e_exp.dst = a.id AND e_exp.src = 'internet'
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON e_of.dst = v.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND e_exp.src = 'internet'
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC, v.epss DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.epss,
  v.kev
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e_on.dst = a.id
JOIN edges e_exp ON e_exp.dst = a.id AND e_exp.src = 'internet'
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON e_of.dst = v.id
JOIN edges e_reach ON e_reach.src = a.id
JOIN datastores ds ON e_reach.dst = ds.id AND ds.crown_jewel = true
WHERE f.status = 'open'
ORDER BY v.kev DESC, v.epss DESC, v.cvss DESC
LIMIT 20;
